output.source_text: A Bebop scale is created by taking a normal 7-note scale and adding 1 chromatic passing note to make it an 8-note scale. This ensures that when playing descending 8th notes, chord tones land consistently on the downbeats.

note_vi: Bài 17 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 01:58-03:03. A Bebop scale is created by taking a normal 7-note scale and adding 1 chromatic passing note to make it an 8-note scale. This ensures that when playing descending 8th notes, chord tones land consistently on the downbeats. Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng.
